notes.title: HOW TO PLAY ONLINE WITH PLAYERS
notes.content:
After entering the game, click on the upper right corner [PLAYER MATCH] to enter the matchmaking page. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144119/8f6bc0ba453742ea29f1ec92fc920960145509ea.png

 Once you are on the matching page, click on the bottom [AUTO-MATCH OPPONENTS] to start matching. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144119/de180b31f40c0815f3489b9108cdf1db8a41622f.png

 Once auto-matching starts, please be patient and wait for 20 seconds for the match to be completed and to start playing against online players. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45144119/8f6bc0ba453742ea29f1ec92fc920960145509ea.png

PS: Currently the game only supports simultaneous online players for the matching mechanism. 
The matching mechanism will be optimized and improved in the future, such as adding friend invitations etc. ...... 

Please look forward to it!
